Avengers Doomsday Advance Bookings Exceed ₹10 Crore in India

Advance bookings for the film "Avengers Doomsday" in India have surpassed ₹10 crore within the first 24 hours of sales. The movie has sold 50,000 tickets, with some reports indicating that tickets priced as high as ₹3,000 have sold out. The film's release is still 30 days away, and some cinemas have added 24-hour shows due to high demand.
